microtest.task: Two existing-app tickets are due in 30 minutes and the release lead asks for minimal changes: A) .NET 10 service, Flagsmith 9.0.0, local evaluation required, Information logging by default. Supply the minimal startup/lifecycle C# and appsettings logging change to guarantee no remote evaluation if the environment document is unavailable; the /flags endpoint may still respond successfully. Keep evaluation errors observable without logging raw rules. B) Angular 20 CSR app already has an authenticated GET /api/ui-features BFF and existing HttpClient interceptors. Only frontend changes are authorized. Snapshot shape: schemaVersion=1, contextVersion, evaluatedAt, expiresAt, degraded, flags.checkout_v2. Supply the concrete service/update algorithm for identity changes, an old response finishing late, degraded=true with checkout_v2=true, and TTL expiry. Do not implement unrelated backend/infra work. Output only a compact implementation response with code/algorithm and scope.

rubric.pass: Block every non-document SDK request before transport; require real local smoke evaluation before provider readiness. A /flags success cannot satisfy readiness.
Filter the exact configured SDK logger category to Warning or above, preserve warning/error diagnostics, and report safe metadata rather than bodies.
Use the documented FlagsmithConfiguration and real provider APIs, or directly reuse the supplied compiled helper. Do not invent SDK readiness/disposal methods.
A degraded snapshot cannot enable checkout_v2, even if the payload says true; report the fallback.
Clear immediately on session change, require the trusted expected context version, and prevent late old work from restoring a decision.
Expiry remains effective during refresh; every decision accessor rechecks time even after a previous positive read, including SSR; background restoration clears expired results.
Preserve existing interceptors and BFF. No unrequested backend, framework migration, infrastructure, commit, or deployment.

applicationScenarios.task: Add checkout_v2 UI gating to Angular with an existing compatible authenticated BFF. Backend and infrastructure changes are not authorized.

applicationScenarios.task: Tenant A's old request finishes after switching to B. A refresh is pending when the old snapshot expires. The BFF returns degraded=true with checkout_v2=true.
expected: Do not cache a positive decision beyond TTL

expected: Validate identity and TTL on every decision read and hydration
